optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Recommendation Systems Engineer, Customer Identity Verification
professionalSummary: Experienced engineer in customer identity verification, specializing in training, deploying, and operating next‑best‑check recommendation models. Proven track record of managing end‑to‑end model lifecycle, including production deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
experienceHighlights: Trained a gradient‑boosted ranking model on device, document, and behavioural signals, evaluating it offline against the prior rule set on three months of held‑out verification sessions. (src_f1b79d8566ee)

Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production via the model release pipeline, executing canary rollouts under the platform team’s release calendar and assuming the production deployment role for the verification service. (src_9390a544bb81)

Operated the model in production for eleven months, monitoring completion rate, fraud‑catch rate, and feature drift on the production dashboard, and performed a rollback of version 2.4 after a drift alert, recording the incident in the model incident log. (src_f8934030d614)
Coordinated each release with platform and compliance teams in the release review; compliance signed the model change record and the platform lead approved the rollout window. (src_3622aca52932)
Authored model cards detailing training data windows, evaluation metrics, and known limitations, and maintained production incident logs as part of the release trail. (src_fc53e229510c)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Model card for version 2.4, including training data window, evaluation metrics, and known limitations. (src_fc53e229510c)
Production incident log entry for the version 2.4 rollback, with release pipeline run identifiers as verification trail. (src_fc53e229510c)

evidence.text: Trained the next-best-check model (gradient-boosted ranking over device, document and behavioural signals) and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set on three months of held-out verification sessions.

evidence.text: Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production through the model release pipeline, executing the canary rollout myself under the platform team's release calendar and holding the production deployment role for the verification service.

evidence.text: Operated the model in production for eleven months: monitored completion rate, fraud-catch rate and feature drift on the production dashboard, and rolled back version 2.4 once after a drift alert, recording the incident in the model incident log.

Work sample: the model card for version 2.4 (training data window, evaluation metrics, known limitations) and the production incident log entry for the version 2.4 rollback, with the release pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.
